searches.query: I need a bigger size of the same jacket model for a domestic order. The current price went up. What price applies, and how long is an approved replacement held?

chunks.text: Exchanging a size or color  For a domestic order, an eligible unused product can be exchanged for a different size or color of the same model. The exchange keeps the original paid item price even if the current listing price changed. The replacement must be available when the request is approved. Exchanges into a different model are handled as a return followed by a new purchase at the new model's price.  The warehouse holds an approved replacement for seven calendar days. The customer must hand the returning parcel to the carrier within that period. The hold does not last until the parcel physically arrives at the warehouse. If the dispatch deadline passes, the reservation is released and availability must be checked again. Support cannot promise stock from a catalog description.  Exchanges use the same unused-condition and eligibility-window rules as standard returns. The store does not offer direct international exchanges. An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order.

A customer asking for the exact difference on a particular order needs those live values. An ordinary exchange for the same model in a different size follows the exchange-price rule instead. Do not treat a size exchange as a second price adjustment.

Price adjustments after a purchase  If the store lowers the price of the identical model, size, and color within seven calendar days of an online purchase, the purchaser may request one price adjustment. The lower-priced item must be available to buy when the request is made. A price on another retailer's website does not qualify. A different color or size is not an identical item for this policy.  Final-sale outlet items, bundle promotions, gift-card purchases, and one-use personalized coupons are excluded. The adjustment returns the eligible price difference to the original payment method after approval. It does not change the original order date, extend the return window, or remove a product's shipping restrictions.  Support needs the original purchase record and the current matching listing to decide a live request. These policy documents contain the rule, not today's product prices or inventory. A customer asking for the exact difference on a particular order needs those live values.

evidence.text: Exchanging a size or color  For a domestic order, an eligible unused product can be exchanged for a different size or color of the same model. The exchange keeps the original paid item price even if the current listing price changed. The replacement must be available when the request is approved. Exchanges into a different model are handled as a return followed by a new purchase at the new model's price.  The warehouse holds an approved replacement for seven calendar days. The customer must hand the returning parcel to the carrier within that period. The hold does not last until the parcel physically arrives at the warehouse. If the dispatch deadline passes, the reservation is released and availability must be checked again. Support cannot promise stock from a catalog description.  Exchanges use the same unused-condition and eligibility-window rules as standard returns. The store does not offer direct international exchanges. An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order.

A customer asking for the exact difference on a particular order needs those live values. An ordinary exchange for the same model in a different size follows the exchange-price rule instead. Do not treat a size exchange as a second price adjustment.

Price adjustments after a purchase  If the store lowers the price of the identical model, size, and color within seven calendar days of an online purchase, the purchaser may request one price adjustment. The lower-priced item must be available to buy when the request is made. A price on another retailer's website does not qualify. A different color or size is not an identical item for this policy.  Final-sale outlet items, bundle promotions, gift-card purchases, and one-use personalized coupons are excluded. The adjustment returns the eligible price difference to the original payment method after approval. It does not change the original order date, extend the return window, or remove a product's shipping restrictions.  Support needs the original purchase record and the current matching listing to decide a live request. These policy documents contain the rule, not today's product prices or inventory.
